title: Richard S NDE 9500
content: In the Army, I was doing flood duty. It was very hot out all day, so I decided to get a saline IV to rehydrate. After I was hooked up to the IV, I became dizzy, my eyes blurred and I was sweating profusely. My eyes rolled up to the back of my head and my heart stopped. An army medic was nearby. Then, I became part of something I can’t fully describe. I had no more pain. I was euphoric and had no anxiety. I knew I had died and I was very happy! I was resuscitated. When I came back, the pain returned. I was totally pissed at the medic. It seemed like I had been gone for a long time but the medic said I was dead less than 30 seconds. The saline bags had been left out in the sun all day and were roughly 120 degrees, causing my body to go into shock. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 06/2008 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. It was a military mishap caused by the saline bags being too hot. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal.Understood and realized more than I am normally capable of when I was in my body. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Yes Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual Faster Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Wore glasses. Didn’t need glasses during the experience. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was no sound but beautiful quiet. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Can’t describe. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Absolute delight! Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Studied parapsychology since early 1990s and feel that “When the student is ready, the teacher will appear.” Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Belief in afterlife Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I’m ready to go back home. This life is dragging. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life beliefs Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I don’t have the vocabulary to describe the experience. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I remember Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Many years Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Lots of reading What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Military mishap during flood duty: saline IV bags left in the sun and were roughly 120 degrees, causing shock and cardiac arrest.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described becoming "part of something I can’t fully describe" with "beautiful quiet" and no tunnel, light, or beings; reported not needing glasses during the experience.

“Then, I became part of something I can’t fully describe.”
“I had no more pain. I was euphoric and had no anxiety. I knew I had died and I was very happy!”
“There was no sound but beautiful quiet.”
“I don’t have the vocabulary to describe the experience.”
“I’m ready to go back home. This life is dragging.”
